summary: This article explains how Arabic calligraphy turned everyday letters into fine art, the main scripts calligraphers use, and the years of patient practice it takes to master the craft.
introduce: Start a K-W-L chart on the board and ask students what they already Know and what they Want to know about the topic of “Arabic Calligraphy: Writing as Art”. Tell them they will fill in what they Learned after reading.

keyTerms.def: something added to make a place or object look more beautiful
moving or shaped in a smooth, elegant way

challengeTerms.def: a handwritten book or document, often old and valuable
controlled, careful practice built through training and effort
relating to beauty or the appreciation of beauty

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that handwriting can be a real form of art, not just a way to send a message? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain how the scripts and tools of Arabic calligraphy work together to create beautiful writing.
struggling: Pre-teach decoration, graceful, and precise with pictures or gestures, then let weak readers use a K-W-L chart and read the article with a partner.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use manuscript, discipline, and aesthetic in a short paragraph that connects the article to something they learned in another subject.
